raw:
I'll use a factorial design: 10 diverse parent cells, each receiving roughly the same 10 edits. That way each edit's effect can be compared across many different parent conditions. The parents cover all-same-op cells, ResNet-like cells, sparse cells and chain cells. The edits target the edges known to matter most (edges 3 and 5), plus node-1 and node-2 connectivity edits. Where an edit would be a no-op on a parent, I swapped in a close alternative.
